source.method: render 16 frame titles (ASCII x10, CJK x8) at sizes 6-20 on a scratch page, export PNG, measure pixel bbox

anchors.coordinate_system: EasyEDA raw units (1 unit = 0.01 inch), y-up; measured A4 sheet 0..1170 x 0..825 with the title block bottom-right (small y)
anchors.left_top: anchor point is the top-left corner of the line box; bbox extends +x and -y
anchors.left_center: anchor point is the left edge midpoint; bbox extends +x and is centred in y
anchors.center: anchor point is the line-box centre
anchors.right_top: anchor point is the top-right corner of the line box; bbox extends -x and -y
anchors.rotation: not supported by easycirq-text-metrics/v1; rotated text must be blocked, not silently guessed

extrapolation.method: least-squares linear fit over the measured sizes (ASCII/CJK/space: 8-20, height: 8-14); the fit residual on measured sizes is <= 0.34 raw units
extrapolation.reason: the merged rendering samples for sizes 6/7 carried a CJK/height unit error (6 -> cjk 47.71, height 12.65; 7 -> cjk 52.44, height 14.67) and the size-20 height (12.65) broke the 8-14 trend; values are extrapolated and marked, not measured - re-measure before treating them as evidence

6.provenance: extrapolated initial estimate; re-measure from EasyEDA text-list/SVG exports (size 6 not in the rendered sample set)

7.provenance: extrapolated initial estimate; re-measure from EasyEDA text-list/SVG exports (size 7 not in the rendered sample set)

20.provenance: ascii/cjk/space measured from rendered PNG samples (2026-10-29); height extrapolated from the measured 8-14 size trend because the merged 12.65 sample contradicted it - re-measure from EasyEDA text-list/SVG exports
